name: void_bolt_launch
for: void_stalker void bolt: cast between the cupped hands
notes: Space tears open between the hands: a black slit with a violet lip opens like an eye (frames 1-3) while motes are dragged into it, swells and rounds into the hole (4-5), then seals to a point as it is flung +x (6), leaving violet streaks and drifting motes. Anchor = between the hands. 10 frames @12 fps; start void_bolt_flight on frame 6.
